participant_id.Description: release patient code (Pennsieve folder name); codes are the authors' pseudonyms

sex.Description: not stated per patient in the release or the paper (paper Table 1, cohort level: 43 of 75 female, 57.3%)

age.Description: not stated per patient in the release or the paper (paper Table 1, cohort level: 34.7 +/- 12.3 years)

n_seizure_events.Description: number of distinct seizure events with a .mat file

seizure_types.Description: seizure type (field sz_type) : number of events

surgery_type.Description: field surgery_type of the files, as written by the authors (e.g. 'R SAH', 'L TL', 'unknown'); several values joined by ' | '

soz_strings.Description: distinct values of the field raw_soz_string over the patient's seizures (authors' SOZ contacts), joined by ' | '

n_nodes.Description: number of bipolar nodes in the files (range when it differs between seizures)
